description.narrative: The United Nations Secretary General’s Peacebuilding Fund is the organization’s financial instrument of first resort to sustain pace in countries or situations at risk or affected by violent conflict. It responds quickly and with flexibility to opportunities for peacebuilding, catalyzing processes and resources in a risk-tolerant fashion.
